title: The Predator
camera: low angle with a slow pull-back as the predator advances
action: A huge prehistoric big-cat predator steps out of the bushes into the light. KAIRO steps backward in fear and lifts his spear with both hands.
lighting: predator rim-lit by the sun, KAIRO in warm bounce light
audio: deep growl, grass crunch, low brass hit, drone rises
dialogue_fa: وقتی دیدمش، فهمیدم شکارچی واقعی منم! باور کن حتی فرصت نکردم فکر کنم.
gloss_en: When I saw it, I realised I was the real prey! Believe me, I didn't even get a chance to think.
continuity: predator design locked from here to S14
transition: the predator gathers its weight, motivating the cut to the run
image_prompt: Low wide shot in golden savanna grass. A massive prehistoric big-cat predator with low heavy shoulders, a huge head, short rounded ears and a thick tail stands at the edge of the bushes, rim-lit by sunrise, fur tawny-grey with a dark dorsal stripe. In the foreground KAIRO the stickman in a brown hide tunic backs away, wooden spear raised in both hands. 2D cinematic animation, dust, dramatic scale contrast.
video_prompt: Slow pull-back as the predator pushes out of the bushes one heavy step at a time, head low, shoulders rolling. KAIRO stumbles backward, raises the spear with both thin arms and freezes. The predator's tail flicks. Grass and dust move with the weight.
